title: Beef and Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy beef stir fry recipe that serves four and is ready in under 20 minutes. This recipe is gluten-free and perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Chewy vegetables
ingredients.notes: Such as carrots or bell peppers

ingredients.name: Nutty stir-fry sauce
ingredients.notes: See notes for homemade sauce recipe

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the skillet and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the chopped potatoes and cook until they begin to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chewy vegetables to the skillet and cook until they are tender-crisp.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir in the nutty stir-fry sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
